notes: The ungrouped follower gets solo XP while a grouped leader and another grouped follower remain passive in the room; the scenario is R5h-red when the recipient selection is reverted (R1/R3/R5e/R5h).

DeserializePlayer tests prove V1 flag migration and V2 contradictory mirrors both hydrate AutoGold/AutoSplit from the canonical serialized C preference bits without changing the save format (R3/R5e/R5h).

A grouped player leader with a grouped charmed mobile follower kills a trainee; group_gain's divisor and autosplit include the mobile (share wording, NPC gold share, leftover), red when the divisor stays player-only (R1/R5e/R5h).

The grouped charmed mobile lands the killing blow and the player leader still receives the group share; the mobile's own share send, gain_exp, and alignment are skipped (change_alignment returns for NPCs). Draw divergence at the kill pulse is baseline-confirmed and disclosed in the 2026-10-29 handoff (R1/R5a/R5h).
A grouped member in another room neither joins the divisor nor receives a share; the leader's kill takes the solo wording (R1/R5e).

Actor-inclusive divisor: 1000 experience over {player leader, grouped mobile} shares base 495 (500 with the 1% group penalty), zero for the mobile; fails if only NPC acceptance is added while the divisor stays player-only (R5h).
A grouped mobile killer awards the player leader a share and shifts the leader's alignment while the mobile's alignment and experience stay untouched (R5e).
Autosplit pays a grouped mobile member its truncated share in gold (C GET_GOLD(follower) += n) and conserves the looted total (R1/R5e).
With a zero per-member share only follower-loop members see the none-to-split notices; the leader arm exists only while gold_per_member > 0 (R1/R5e).
The killer's share notices follow C order: leader first, then followers newest-first per add_follower's prepend (R1/R3b).

C subtracts the 1% group penalty in floating point and truncates once on assignment: base 150 becomes 148, not 149 (red on main, which pre-truncates the one percent); the first fixture whose divided base exceeds the gate (R1/R5h).

`group <follower>` leaves the leader ungrouped; the autosplit leader block has no AFF_GROUP check, so the ungrouped leader still receives gold_per_member (with share messages) while the divisor and XP loop skip them; three shares of 101 drop the negative leftover.
